scope: CPU-only inference with synthetic_v1 input. ET seed-23 untrained weights, synthetic calibration; not an MLPerf accuracy result or matched-weight comparison.

benchmark.aggregate_percentile: nearest rank across all 300 measured samples per model

definitions.ram_accounted_peak_bytes: Inference method-pool peak (includes planned buffers) + temp-pool peak + EtModel object + retained initialization heap + linked runtime/registry writable static storage. Excludes unused reservations, call-stack high water, harness/platform, and reporting allocations. Heap snapshots verify retained growth, not transient heap peaks.
definitions.et_init_temp_peak_bytes: Initialization high water, reported separately from inference temp peak.
definitions.flash_model_plus_runtime_bytes: Model PTE + retained ET core, kernels, CMSIS-NN and selected registry/bindings. Excludes runner, diagnostics, fixtures, platform/startup, adapter, shared standard libraries/merged strings and linker padding. Component attribution, not standalone firmware size.
definitions.flash_total_bytes: Complete MRAM payload, including support and validation fixtures; excludes SE package metadata/programming padding.

model_source.weights: Untrained initialization; synthetic timing/graph benchmark artifacts
